name: Flexisteel
description: A nanostructured steel alloy that combines the hardness and strength of conventional steel with rubber-like flexibility. Flexisteel beams can deflect 30 degrees and spring back without permanent deformation. Ideal for earthquake-resistant construction and vehicle frames designed to absorb collision energy without crumpling permanently.
